capabilities: Render tikz and luatikz fenced code blocks in reading and live preview
Preview diagrams live while editing, with coordinate picking and hover-to-locate
Draw and edit TikZ visually with shapes, circuits, freehand ink, and touch/stylus support
Render Hebrew and Arabic labels with script-specific fonts and shaping
Export rendered diagrams as SVG or PNG
extras: Local rendering is opt-in and involves shell execution and temporary files; the plugin links out to a detailed security guide. Sample diagrams are included in the repository. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot render TikZ diagrams from code blocks, and doing so normally requires a local TeX toolchain, which mobile devices lack.

relations.evidence: Desktop can use local LuaLaTeX or TikZJax; mobile uses TikZJax.

requires.name: LuaLaTeX (MacTeX or TeX Live) and pdftocairo

summary: TikZ renderer that compiles tikz and luatikz code blocks via local LuaLaTeX or bundled TikZJax, with a visual editor and SVG/PNG export.
